prompt.es: Escribe el mensaje que confirma por escrito lo que acordaron en la reunión del piso.

answer.text: Hi Mia and Tom, I am writing to confirm what we agreed in the meeting. Just to recap, we will split the bills equally, Tom will pay the internet, and Mia will buy the cleaning products. The cleaning rota starts on Monday and changes every week. Guests may stay for two nights, provided that we tell each other in advance. As discussed, the deposit will be divided equally, and everybody will have paid it no later than the fifth. I would like to have all of this in writing, so there is no misunderstanding later. If anything is different from your notes, please reply today and I will correct it. Thanks for being so flexible. I think this is a fair package for all of us, and I am sure the flat will be a good place to live.
accepted: Hi Mia and Tom, I am writing to confirm what we agreed in the meeting. Just to recap, we will split the bills equally, Tom will pay the internet, and Mia will buy the cleaning products. The cleaning rota starts on Monday and changes every week. Guests may stay for two nights, provided that we tell each other in advance. As discussed, the deposit will be divided equally, and everybody will have paid it no later than the fifth. I would like to have all of this in writing, so there is no misunderstanding later. If anything is different from your notes, please reply today and I will correct it. Thanks for being so flexible. I think this is a fair package for all of us, and I am sure the flat will be a good place to live.

Dear both, here is a short summary of our meeting. To recap, each of us will pay a third of the bills, and Tom will take care of the internet in exchange for Mia buying the cleaning products. The rota for cleaning begins on Monday. We agreed that guests can stay for two nights as long as we warn the others beforehand. The deposit will be split equally, and we will have paid it by the fifth. Please check this message and let me know in writing if you see a misunderstanding. Otherwise, I will consider everything confirmed. I am really happy that we reached this agreement, and I look forward to living with you both, because this is a fair package for everybody.

feedback.es: Un buen mensaje de confirmación resume lo pactado, repite las condiciones y pide corregir cualquier malentendido por escrito.
